business.description: Sinclairs Hotels Limited operates hotels and resorts across leisure destinations in India, including West Bengal, Sikkim, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Ooty, and Udaipur.

plants.location: Sinclairs Bayview Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

plants.capacity: Hotel at Udaipur Location - Sinclairs Palace Retreat Udaipur on a non cancellable lease of 9 years

products.name: Food and beverage sale
products.note: Recognised when food and beverages are sold

products.name: Banquet services
products.note: Recognised when banquet services have been provided as per contract

products.name: Rooms, Food and Beverage & Banquets
products.note: Revenue is recognised at the transaction price that is allocated to the performance obligation. Revenue includes room revenue, food and beverage sale and banquet services which is recognised once the rooms are occupied, food and beverages are sold and banquet services have been provided as per the contract with the customer.

products.name: Other Allied Services
products.note: In relation to car hire income, laundry income, communication income, health club income, airport transfers income and other allied services, the revenue has been recognised by reference to the time of service rendered.

products.name: Membership Fee
products.note: In relation to Membership fee which entitles the members the access to the club is recognized as income equally over the period of lease on which the club is constructed.

products.name: Food and Beverages
products.note: Revenue from food and beverage services

outlook.statement: Industry outlook for the hospitality sector remains favourable over the near to medium term. Sustained domestic travel demand, recovery in international tourist arrivals, and continued momentum in the MICE and wedding segments are expected to support revenue growth. Improved air connectivity, expansion of regional airports, and increased focus on tourism promotion are likely to further augment demand across key destinations.

capex_plans.item: Expansion by way of both greenfield projects as well as acquiring existing properties on lease

risks: adverse weather conditions at key tourist destinations impacting seasonality and occupancy
rising costs relating to power, fuel, food inputs, and employee expenses
denial of input GST in hotel's room revenues
Risk of overstatement of revenue due to fraud resulting from pressure to achieve targets and earning expectations
Actuarial risks such as longevity risk, currency risk, interest rate risk and market (investment) risk from defined benefit plans
Credit risk from trade receivables, investments in mutual funds, corporate bonds and bank deposits
Liquidity risk in meeting financial liabilities
Market risk from price fluctuations in FVTPL investments (mutual funds)
Interest rate risk from changes in market interest rates
Counterparty risk from non-performance of contractual obligations

auditor.name: B S R & Co. LLP
auditor.opinion: no qualifications, adverse remarks or disclaimer
key_audit_matters: Revenue recognition - risk of overstatement due to fraud from pressure to achieve targets and earning expectations
